#include <bits/stdc++.h>

using namespace std;

using ll = long long;
using pii = pair<int, int>;

const int MOD1 = 998244353;
const int MOD2 = 1000000007;
const int BASE = 1000000;

int n, total, sum_arr[15], result;
vector<int> buckets[15];

void dfs1(int depth, int num);
void dfs2(int x);

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    
    cin >> n;
    dfs1(0, 0);
    
    for (int i = 0; i <= 7; ++i) {
        sort(buckets[i].begin(), buckets[i].end());
    }
    
    total = 0;
    for (int i = 1; i <= 9; ++i) {
        dfs2(i);
    }
    
    cout << result << '\n';
    return 0;
}

void dfs1(int depth, int num) {
    if (depth == 7) return;
    
    total++;
    int val = ((total - num) % MOD1 + MOD1) % MOD1;
    buckets[depth].push_back(val);
    sum_arr[depth] = (sum_arr[depth] + val) % MOD2;
    
    for (int digit = 0; digit <= 9; ++digit) {
        dfs1(depth + 1, num * 10 + digit);
    }
}

void dfs2(int x) {
    if (x > n) return;
    
    if (x * BASE + BASE - 1 <= n && x * BASE * 10 > n) {
        int current_total = total;
        for (int i = 0, multiplier = 1; i <= 6; ++i, multiplier *= 10) {
            int sz = buckets[i].size();
            int diff = ((current_total - x * multiplier) % MOD1 + MOD1) % MOD1;
            int pos = lower_bound(buckets[i].begin(), buckets[i].end(), MOD1 - diff) - buckets[i].begin();
            result = (result + diff * sz + sum_arr[i]) % MOD2;
            result = (result - MOD1 * (sz - pos) % MOD2 + MOD2) % MOD2;
            total += sz;
        }
        return;
    }
    
    total++;
    int val = ((total - x) % MOD1 + MOD1) % MOD1;
    result = (result + val) % MOD2;
    
    for (int digit = 0; digit <= 9; ++digit) {
        dfs2(x * 10 + digit);
    }
}
